_noteW: Pick a Card FIXED (loop 221). All three cards' calcs (BlueDamage/RedDamage/GoldDamage) sum a flat base + 100% total AD + a per-card AP ratio, PLUS a StatBySubPartCalculationPart keyed on mStat=8 (crit chance) wrapping the crit-scaling bonus -- that mStat=8 term resolves to 0.0 in the current engine (§26 no-crit floor), so it contributes 0 and each card's base formula resolves cleanly (matching each card's wiki-documented 0%-floor value exactly): Blue 40/60/80/100/120 (+100% AD)(+100% AP), Red 30/45/60/75/90 (+100% AD)(+70% AP), Gold 15/22.5/30/37.5/45 (+100% AD)(+50% AP), all Magic. Since exactly ONE of the three cards lands per W cast (a player choice, mutually exclusive -- summing all three would overcount), only 'BlueDamage' (the highest raw-damage card, the natural pick for an all-in damage combo) is curated as W's hit; Red (slow) and Gold (stun) are situational CC picks with lower raw damage, not modeled here to avoid conflating three exclusive outcomes into one number (documented, not an oversight).
